paper_title: Can We Edit LLMs for Long-Tail Biomedical Knowledge
caption: : The performance of knowledge probing after editing with different editing methods on BioGPT and Llama2, where “Base” denotes LLM without editing.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and accuracy percentage across different methods. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number", with a exponential scale ranging from 0 to 1000, and tick labels at 10, 100, and 1000. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" and employs a linear scale ranging from 60 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot features six lines differentiated by color and style. The black solid line with circles, representing "Base", starts at an accuracy of 63% at a co-occurrence number of 5 and rises to 68% bit beyond 10^3. The blue dashed line with downward triangles, labeled "FT", begins at 64% at 5 and increases to 70% over the same range. The red solid line with upward triangles, "IKE", starts at 66% and reaches 72% bit beyond 10^3. The brown line with diamond markers, "MEND", shows an increase from 69% at 5 to 76% bit beyond 10^3. The purple line with pentagon markers, "MEMIT", begins at 68% at 5 and goes up to 75% bit beyond 10^3. The green line with square markers, labeled "ROME," starts at 73% at 5 and rises to 81% bit beyond 10^3. Each line exhibits a generally upward trend across the x-axis range. No lines intersect each other. There are 4 markers in each line. A legend is given in top left, describing the line and color.
